# erp-readiness
Read AGENTS.md and relevant rules. Inspect authorized landscape evidence and classify gaps. Produce templates/customer-readiness.json. Verify network, identity, environment, sign-off, licensing, cost and support separately. Stop before any live access.
## Evidence
Record source, environment, exact revision, unknowns, validation results and proof level. Stop when any applicable gate is missing. Use deterministic tests rather than model confidence.
